name: cpenta
notes: The official Nastran-to-Radioss conversion mapping changes CPENTA15 to first order before conversion.
Only the first six corner nodes are retained for the solid pentahedron.
The first-order pentahedron is represented as a degenerated 8-node /BRICK by repeating the appropriate corner nodes.
Do not generate /BRIC20 for CPENTA15 in this translator.
